sentences.text: Uruguaysuchus was related to the genera Simosuchus and Malawisuchus.
In 1932, approximately seven individuals of small terrestrial crocodiles were discovered during a water well drilling in Guichón, Paysandú department, Uruguay.
Carlos Rusconi described the new genus Uruguaysuchus and two new species, U. aznarezi and U. terrai, in 1933.
Uruguaysuchus remains the best-represented Mesozoic vertebrate in Uruguay.
Uruguaysuchus is classified within the superorder Crocodylomorpha.
Uruguaysuchus belongs to the suborder Notosuchia.
Uruguaysuchus is the type genus of the family Uruguaysuchidae.
Uruguaysuchus lived during the Late Cretaceous in the Guichón Formation of Uruguay.
The time range for Uruguaysuchus is from the Cenomanian to the Santonian, between 100.5 and 83.6 million years ago.
